title: NEW SAVES COUNT EACH KILL ONCE
why: Found in the cloud audit of 2026-10-28 (lint class C, now that it runs). A new save is not born with achScan, the stamp of the one-time scan that credits runs from before live counting. Live runs already add their kills (achRun with live true), so the first time a new save opens its stats page the scan adds every logged run a second time. Proven in headless Chromium on v35.38: two runs of 7 pillager kills read 14, then 28 after the first look at the stats page, and the 25 kill medal unlocked; machines went 60 to 120. Fix: the born profile carries achScan:1 like mig739 and dayMigrated. Old saves are untouched (a loaded save replaces the literal whole), so a save from before live counting still gets its one scan.
now: new saves count each kill once for medals
